notes.title: Update 1.0.7 fix bug pants weren't dropped
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We just updated the game to version 1.0.7 fix bug pants weren't dropped in the version 1.0.6.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 added Fap mode
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We added new mode in version 1.0.5 name "Fap mode"
If you choose this mode when starting a new game or changing difficult in the game setting screen, all CGs will be unlocked.
(You need to install DLC or Patch to have this mode)

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We just updated the game to version 1.0.4 with several changes and bug fixes:
- Niko is now accept drink anywhere
- Change some text in Chinese for easier to understand about the "nightdate"
- Fix bug that cannot unlock the 4th image in the gallery
We are working on Trading Cards and post game mode, hope everything will be available next week!
Nice weekend everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 gallery and date gift bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fix Firecrackers and Clover date gift have not working
- After unlock every preferences and details of the girl, she will not telling you to ask her a question
- Fix Masami's ingame job
- Fix Sara's birthday when she quiz you about that
- Fix gallery not unlock the last two images
Please rewatch the 2nd hscene for every girl to unlock the last two image

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 lowering night date difficulty and bug fixes
notes.content:
- Game balance:
+ Lowering the decrease speed of affection at the final night date
+ Decrease price of some item
+ Fix bug that select a query give you a wrong amount of Lovences
- Now when you click New Game, the game will ask for difficult selection
- Fix bug sometimes character visual look strange
- Both successful and fail a date now give more Credits
- Update Sara's birthday info for match with her zodiac

notes.title: Adorable Crush beta test invitation!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Our upcoming game Adorable Crush will be coming next month.
To prepare for it, we would like to hearing your feedbacks via a beta test event for everyone who is luckily chosen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401857/813e981399aa2f80b94c7859ab7bc1e957cc3285.jpg
Here is the instruction:
- Entry time: From now to 05:00 PM 17/9/2020 (PDT)
- Beta time: 05:00 PM 23/09/2020 - 05:00 PM 26/9/2020 (PDT)
- Entry: Comment your number here to entry (from 1-100)
- Formula: We will use random.org to random 10 numbers, who have commented that number (or nearest number) will be selected.
For anyone with the same number, earlier comments will be selected.
